caption: The drawing depicts a trapezoidal, skirt-shaped object with a bright red background placed centrally on a plain, off-white canvas. On the red surface, there is a large, intricate floral design consisting of three prominent flowers, two round and peach-colored, and one larger, stylized flower at the upper center with light pink and white striped petals. Several leaves, varying in shades of dark brown, black, gray, and vivid yellow-green, extend outward from the center, with detailed veining and texture. The floral elements are arranged in a symmetrical manner, occupying most of the red area, while small, white dot-like accents are scattered around the design. The overall image is framed by the red trapezoidal shape with no other decorative elements outside it. The artist’s signature, "C. Herzing," appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
